title: Title and track select (S6) with stripe screen change
summary: The start screen becomes S6: a navy title panel (heading, triple stripe, SVG player car) and a dirt ground with SELECT TRACK, one radio card per track (centreline SVG outline passed in by the game, name, B07 stored best), the selected card mustard, and RACE. Cards aren't buttons, so RACE stays the first, focused button and existing createStartScreen tests (and its subtitle option) still pass. Settings is out of scope. QUIT TO MENU plays the triple-stripe sweep (250 ms, 40 ms apart). RACE, RETRY and NEXT RACE play a chequer band. State changes at once under the overlay. Direct startRace() calls (the driver) get no overlay, and reduced motion cuts it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: AC1: The menu shows the label SELECT TRACK and a radiogroup named "Select track" with exactly one radio card per registered track, in registry order (Bramble Bends, Dust Bowl, Hay Loop today). Each card shows its track name and holds an SVG outline with a non-empty drawn path.

AC2: Each card shows its stored best from localStorage key racer.bestLap.<trackId>, e.g. 40370 shows "BEST 0:40.37". A track with no stored value, an invalid value, or storage that throws shows "BEST –:––.––" and the menu still renders.

AC3: Exactly one card has aria-checked="true", and on first load it is the first registered track. Clicking another card selects it and unselects the old one. With a card focused, ArrowRight/ArrowLeft move the selection to the next/previous card, wrapping at the ends.

AC4: Selecting the Hay Loop card and pressing RACE starts a six-car race on Hay Loop (game state mode 'race', trackId 'hay-loop', 6 cars). After QUIT TO MENU the Hay Loop card is the selected one, and RACE stays the menu's focused primary button.
AC5: If a track's stored best changes during a race (e.g. localStorage racer.bestLap.dust-bowl set to 39990), that card reads "BEST 0:39.99" after QUIT TO MENU.
AC6: The title panel holds the DAILY AI RACER heading, the triple stripe (red, mustard, cream) and an SVG image of the player car with an accessible name containing "#1".

AC7: Pressing QUIT TO MENU on the pause screen puts the menu on show at once, under a screen-change element ([data-screen-change="stripes"]) holding three stripes (red, mustard, cream). The element is gone 330 ms later (250 ms wipe + 2 × 40 ms stagger, fake timers).

AC8: Pressing RACE on the menu, or RETRY or NEXT RACE on the results screen, shows a [data-screen-change="chequer"] band that is gone 330 ms later. Calling the game's startRace() directly (as the test driver does) adds no screen-change element.

playtest.whatYoullSee: The opening menu now looks like the S6 mockup. A navy title panel with the game name, three stripes and the red #1 car is on the left. On the right is a dirt panel with a card for each track: its outline, name and your best lap, with the selected card in mustard and a red RACE button. Starting a race sweeps a chequered band across the screen, and quitting back to the menu sweeps the red, mustard and cream stripes.
howToTest: Open the preview in landscape on your phone; the menu shows SELECT TRACK with three track cards, each with a drawn outline and a BEST time (dashes if you've never raced it).
Tap the Hay Loop card: it turns mustard and the others go back to plain.
Tap RACE: a chequered band sweeps across and the race starts on Hay Loop.
Finish a lap, then tap PAUSE and QUIT TO MENU: the three stripes sweep across and the menu comes back with Hay Loop still selected.
Check that the Hay Loop card's BEST now shows the lap time you just set.
